page.layout: One page of index entries in a single column, headed "INDEX" with "X." beside it; entries run from the top to the foot, with page references at the right, and the catchword "quos" at the lower right.

main_text.l: Vinculo conjugii stringi satius quàm laqueis satanæ 314
Viri amor in uxorem qualis esse debeat 213. 94.
Viri quomodo se erga omnis generis mulieres gerere
jus in uxores ipsis satis notum 351

page.notes: The running head reads "I N D E X" with a large decorative capital and a following "X." beside it; I have given only the word INDEX as the running head. The entry "Vas pro corpore accipitur" has a struck-through reference that reads as 574 or 574 with 477; marked [?]. The "540" for Valeria is read as printed and may be 340. The "Vinculo" line wraps: "314" is the page reference printed on its own line below the entry. Long s in "stringi", "satius" and "satanæ" is read as a plain s, and the original may show f-like forms.
